root.label: US deportations of third-country nationals to Africa

events.label: US deportations of third-country nationals to Africa

slots.name: accepting countries
slots.sentence: Around a dozen African countries have accepted third-country deportees from the U.S., some in exchange for millions of dollars in payments, though details of the South Sudan deal remain murky.

slots.name: deportees to Africa
slots.sentence: Hundreds have been deported from the U.S. to African countries that aren’t their home nations, according to advocacy groups Human Rights First and Refugees International, which have been monitoring the deportations.
